title: Minimal home page on acme.example for the first production deploy
description: Decided in review batch 1 (acme-59o.1, A8, call 1, owner's answer): once production is deployed, acme.example shows the home page in a more minimal design, keeping the hero and the contact form, instead of a holding page. The app works beneath it. The full home page follows when the marketing site goes public (acme-kme.2). Any change to what visitors see goes through the home spec (docs/product/marketing-home.md).

title: Confirm the app offers what the home page's questions say
description: The home page's questions (docs/product/marketing-home.md HOME-R23, answers in frontend/src/app/(marketing)/_content/questions.ts once Task 6 of the marketing plan lands) claim three abilities: a shared list stays open until a date its owner sets (HOME-R25), the owner can hide any item from viewers (HOME-R26), and the owner can invite a co-owner. HOME-R25 and HOME-R26 allow only what the app lets the owner do, and the app has no product spec yet (the glossary also says a list closes when its owner leaves). Before the site goes public, the owner confirms each ability ships (O4 decided per-list expiry), or the answers are reworded. The item-review spec (acme-n29.3) carries the hiding. Found by the Task 2 review.
close_reason: Approved in review batch 1, round 1 (M40). Call 1 is the owner's: the co-owner answer says anyone the owner adds can edit (acme-4xw).

title: Spec: review items (hide, approve contributed items)
description:
NEEDS BEFORE IT STARTS
- O2 (hiding renames the item's files), O12 (contributed items are approved first)
- The review flow's batch mode of the product-spec skill
- The competitor profiles that cover this feature (docs/competitors/)

WHERE IT STOPS FOR THE OWNER
Nowhere while drafting. Your approval comes once, in the review batch.

Plan: Stage 2. Drafted by an agent, approved by the owner in review batch 1 (label batch-1); the bead closes when the owner approves. Written by the project-manager session on 2026-09-29; chart: https://claude.ai/artifact/ExampleChart0000
acceptance_criteria:
- A one-page pitch leads its review card, so you can judge the direction in a minute
- docs/product/<feature>.md exists with status draft, every section filled, and passes the skill's self-check
- Every product question is a card in the review batch with a recommendation; every assumption is listed so you can veto it
- After your approval: status approved with the date, the spec index updated, new shared rules and glossary terms added, and the bead closed
close_reason: Approved in review batch 1, round 1. Call 1: the owner can also delete an item someone contributed (REV-R48 to R60, REV-P5); its design review is acme-arc.
